name: mosszip-studio
description: MossZip Studio - Premium File Compressor & Document Conversion Platform

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('node', ['server/index.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:icon: node -e "const pngToIco = require('png-to-ico').default; const fs = require('fs'); pngToIco('build/icon.png').then(buf => fs.writeFileSync('build/icon.ico', buf));"

author: Ambali Parambil Shubham
